description: Returns a per-day download time series for an npm package over a period from keyless api.npmjs.org — the raw signal for trend and growth-rate detection. Lets autonomous agents compute momentum/decline and feed agent-to-agent dependency-selection scoring. Ranking surface for trajectory. First call FREE per wallet — send header X-WALLET: 0x<addr>. No charge on upstream failure. [x402: 0.001 USDC per call on Base]

end.description: End date text in YYYY-MM-DD form, paired with start for an explicit npm start:end range. The pair overrides period. A lone end is ignored in favor of period/default. Calendar validity, interval ordering and upstream range limits are not validated locally.

period.description: Named npm daily-download range: last-day, last-week or last-month. Defaults to last-week when a complete start/end pair is absent. Nonempty start and end together override period; unsupported period values are rejected only on the named-range branch.

start.description: Start date text in YYYY-MM-DD form for an explicit npm start:end range. Used only when end is also nonempty; the pair overrides period. A lone start is ignored in favor of period/default. The current backend forwards date text without local calendar or ordering validation.

name: npm_downloads_range
